answer: Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The umber decay curve is applied at each close, signal records the drop, and pulse recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. Every extra alias adds 5 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
